title: Senior Platform Security Engineer
Staff AI/GPU Cloud Engineer
description_html: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for  all .    Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.    About our Team    Our Cloud Platform Engineering team is responsible for building secure, scalable, and resilient multi-cloud infrastructure that enables business-critical applications, AI initiatives, and enterprise services. We partner closely with Security, Infrastructure, Data, Application Development, and AI teams to deliver automated cloud platforms, GPU-enabled compute environments, and modern operational capabilities across AWS, Azure, and GCP.   Position Overview    We are seeking a Cloud Platform Engineer to design, implement, automate, and support secure cloud platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP. This role will focus on cloud architecture, Infrastructure-as-Code, automation, AI enablement, GPU infrastructure, and operational excellence while ensuring security, scalability, and governance standards are maintained across multi-cloud environment!   Responsibilities   Design, deploy, and operate secure, scalable cloud infrastructure and platform services across AWS, Azure, and GCP.  Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code, automation frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines using Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, and PowerShell.  Support enterprise AI, machine learning, and GPU-based workloads by managing compute platforms, capacity, performance, and operational readiness.  Implement cloud security controls, governance policies, monitoring solutions, and resiliency standard processes to ensure platform stability and compliance.  Collaborate with infrastructure, security, data, and application teams to define platform standards, review architectures, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.    Minimum Qualifications   5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting cloud solutions in at least two major public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP).  3+ years of hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, or Bicep.  3+ years of scripting and automation experience using Python, PowerShell, or equivalent programming languages.  Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines and automating cloud operations in enterprise environments.  Experience deploying and managing cloud networking, security controls, IAM, governance frameworks, and hybrid connectivity solutions.    Preferred Qualifications   Experience deploying and supporting AI, machine learning, or generative AI workloads in cloud environments.  Hands-on experience managing GPU-based infrastructure for AI/ML training and inference workloads.  Experience demonstrating AI services, LLMs, AI agents, or cloud-native AI platforms to automate operations and infrastructure management.  Experience with Kubernetes and containerized platform operations in large-scale cloud environments.  Strong architecture, platform engineering, and collaborator collaboration experience, including participation in architecture reviews and Agile delivery teams.        As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future.  We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget.  Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.  Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays.   For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on         micron.com/careers/benefits       .
